# Sanchar Infratech Pvt Ltd

> Premier Multidisciplinary Architecture, Civil Engineering & Project Management Consultancy in Rajasthan, India. Established in 2001 with 25+ years of engineering excellence.

## Company Summary
Sanchar Infratech Pvt. Ltd. is a leading infrastructure and architectural engineering consultancy headquartered in Jaipur, Rajasthan. With over 25 years of operational excellence, 250+ completed landmark builds, and over 12 million square feet constructed, Sanchar Infratech specializes in turnkey civil construction, high-rise residential towers, commercial complexes, healthcare facilities, sports stadiums, and heritage conservation.

## Core Service Lines

### 1. Civil Engineering & Turnkey Construction
- **Scope**: Large-scale civil infrastructure, high-rise structural builds, commercial complexes, healthcare facilities (e.g., Pt. Deen Dayal Upadhyay Hospital - ₹55 Cr), and sports stadiums (SMS Stadium expansion).
- **Standards**: Zero-compromise safety protocols, 24/7 site surveillance, IGBC green building compliance, and carbon-neutral construction techniques.

### 2. Architectural Design & Urban Master Planning
- **Scope**: Multidisciplinary architectural design, master planning, 3D BIM modeling, facade engineering, interior spatial layout, and environmental planning.
- **Specialization**: Fusion of cutting-edge modern architectural aesthetics with traditional Astro-Vastu spatial balance.

### 3. Project Management Consultancy (PMC)
- **Scope**: Full lifecycle project governance, cost estimation, quality assurance, regulatory compliance, contractor oversight, and site safety audits.

### 4. Expert Astro-Vastu Consultancy
- **Scope**: Scientific Vastu spatial planning and astrological orientation integrated seamlessly into residential, commercial, and industrial architectural layouts.
